iti58:1.1: (Tik. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti58:2.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave taṇhā. Katamā tisso? Kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā, imā kho bhikkhave tisso taṇhā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti58:3.1: Taṇhāyogena saṃyuttā rattacittā bhavābhave | te yogayuttā mārassa ayogakkhemino janā | sattā gacchanti saṃsāraṃ jātimaraṇagāmino ||
iti58:4.1: Ye ca taṇhaṃ pahantvāna vītataṇhā bhavābhave | te ca pāraṃgatā loke ye pattā āsavakkhayan-ti ||
iti58:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||9||
